channel.title: Known Route
channel.description: Calm, source-first guides that help ordinary people spot scams, secure accounts, and make safer choices online.

item.title: Your Phone Is Lost: What to Do in the First Hour
item.description: A calm first-hour plan for a lost or stolen iPhone or Android phone: locate it, lock it, contact the carrier, protect accounts, and decide when to erase.

item.title: Is Public Wi-Fi Safe Enough for Banking?
item.description: A practical guide to banking and other sensitive tasks on public Wi-Fi, including HTTPS, hotspot checks, cellular alternatives, VPN limits, and cleanup steps.

item.title: Choosing a Password Manager Without a 40-Feature Spreadsheet
item.description: A product-neutral checklist for choosing a password manager, covering built-in and standalone options, MFA, recovery, autofill, exports, and device support.

item.title: How Long Can You Safely Delay a Software Update?
item.description: A practical way to decide when to install a software update, including urgent security fixes, ordinary updates, restarts, backups, and unsupported devices.

item.title: That Unpaid Toll Text: Three Checks Before You Pay
item.description: A three-check guide to unpaid-toll text messages: spot pressure tactics, verify through an official route, and recover if you already paid or shared information.

item.title: Where to Keep Backup and Recovery Codes
item.description: A practical storage plan for backup codes and recovery keys, including paper copies, separate locations, digital vaults, and replacement rules.

item.title: Before You Scan: A QR Code Scam Checklist
item.description: A practical QR code safety checklist for parking meters, packages, texts, payments, and unexpected signs, plus what to do after a risky scan.

item.title: Your Bank Is Calling About Fraud. Hang Up Anyway.
item.description: What to do when someone claiming to be your bank calls about fraud: hang up, verify through a trusted channel, and never move money to protect it.

item.title: The 10-Minute Account Safety Reset
item.description: A prioritized ten-minute account security checklist covering email, passkeys or MFA, recovery details, sessions, and software updates.

item.title: Passkeys, in Plain English: What Changes When You Turn One On
item.description: A practical explanation of passkeys, why they resist phishing, where they are stored, and what to check before enabling one.
